superposition.label: Superposition
superposition.intro: With two wires a superposition spreads over 2^n outcomes. Each qubit can hold its own, independently.

phase.label: Phase
phase.intro: Global phase stays invisible. Relative phase now includes a two-qubit form: CZ flips the sign of one basis state and nothing else.

interference.label: Interference
interference.intro: A phase you cannot measure becomes a probability you can, once a second layer of H gates folds it back into amplitude.

entanglement.label: Entanglement
entanglement.intro: The pair has a state but neither qubit does. Both Bloch vectors shrink toward the origin; the length is how much of the qubit's own identity is left.

separability.label: Separability
separability.intro: Not every two-qubit gate entangles. These circuits use CX, CZ and SWAP and stay completely separable - the counterexample that stops the assumption.

measurement.label: Measurement
measurement.intro: Four outcomes instead of two. Bit order is q1q0 - Qiskit is little-endian, so the left character is the higher qubit index.

state_evolution.label: State evolution
state_evolution.intro: Step through the circuit one gate at a time. Entangling gates return a null rotation because they are not a Bloch rotation at all.

reversibility.label: Reversibility
reversibility.intro: CX, CZ and SWAP are each their own inverse. Applying one twice returns the state exactly, which is how algorithms free their scratch qubits.

explain.concept_intro: Global phase stays invisible. Relative phase now has a two-qubit form: CZ flips the sign of one basis state and nothing else.

explain.what_happens: Phase gates rotate amplitudes without changing their magnitudes. CZ is the two-qubit form: it flips the sign of the |11> amplitude and leaves every probability untouched.
watch: The probability bars are unchanged by the phase gate — only the amplitude signs move.
The state vector panel is the only place this is visible.

uses: CZ marking a single basis state by sign is exactly how a search oracle flags the answer without changing any probability.
Controlled phase rotations are the main ingredient of the Quantum Fourier Transform.

cases.label: H q0 · H q0
cases.note: Constructive: the two paths reinforce on |0>.

explain.concept_intro: A phase you cannot measure becomes a probability you can, once a second layer of H gates folds it back into amplitude.
explain.what_happens: The first layer of H gates spreads the state, the middle gate adds a phase nothing can measure, and the final layer folds that phase back into amplitude — where it finally shows up in the bars.
watch: The middle gate leaves the probabilities completely unchanged.
Only after the final H layer do the bars move.
Final Bloch lengths: q0 1.0000, q1 1.0000.
uses: Interference is the source of quantum speedup: circuits are arranged so wrong answers cancel and the right one reinforces.
The H-phase-H pattern here is the two-qubit version of an interferometer.
try_next: Remove the middle gate and compare — everything returns to |00>.

cases.label: H q0 · CX q0->q1
cases.note: The Bell state. Both Bloch vectors collapse to the origin.

explain.concept_intro: The pair has a state but neither qubit does. Both Bloch vectors shrink toward the origin.
explain.summary: Maximally entangled — both Bloch lengths fall to 0.0000.
explain.what_happens: The pair now has a single joint state and neither qubit has one of its own. Both Bloch vectors sit at the origin, yet the joint panels are perfectly well defined — the information moved out of the individual qubits and into the correlation between them.
watch: Only 00 and 11 ever appear; the other outcomes are exactly 0.
Both Bloch lengths read 0.0000 while purity drops to 0.5000.
Step 2 is where the entanglement appears.
Final Bloch lengths: q0 0.0000, q1 0.0000.
uses: Entanglement is the resource behind quantum teleportation, superdense coding and device-independent cryptography.
Bell pairs are the standard test of whether real hardware is working: measured correlations that beat the classical limit prove the qubits are genuinely quantum.
